detail.title: Mechanical Accountability in WAKE Architecture
detail.summary: WAKE ensures accountability through a bifurcated architecture that separates model-driven inquiry from source-backed evidentiary synthesis. The collector module restricts retrieval to a hardened list of scholarly hosts and imposes an explicit boundary where model requests act as research questions rather than self-validated findings. Governance protocols, derived from interdisciplinary frameworks, define these accountability structures as deliberate design choices that displace the need for machine-autonomous morality with verifiable institutional audit trails.
